newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury's Adriano to take over early.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury's Adriano to take over early.

text.p: Britain's J. Sainsbury Plc said Dino Adriano will take over as chief executive of its core UK supermarkets division on March 8 rather than at the end of 1997 as previously planned.

Adriano, currently deputy chief executive of the supermarkets unit, will take over from Tom Vyner. Vyner as deputy chairman will concentrate on international buying until he retires at the end of 1997, the company said in a statement.

Sainsbury said that since January 1996, when it announced that Adriano would succeed Vyner at the end of 1997, David Bremner had joined as chief executive of the group's home improvement stores and its American businesses.
This had enabled Adriano to concentrate fully on the UK supermarket business.
"Accordingly, Dino Adriano will take over from Tom Vyner as from the end of the financial year 1996/97 (March 8) as chief executive of the supermarket business," the company said.
